hotel_name: Grand Hyatt Indian Wells Resort & Villas

claims.text: The resort is in Greater Palm Springs and has a golf course.

findings.quote: Nestled in Greater Palm Springs, Grand Hyatt Indian Wells Resort & Villas offers world-class accommodations, luxury spa services, a golf course and outdoor recreational opportunities.
findings.note: Covers both the Greater Palm Springs location and the golf course.

claims.text: The resort's pools are set against a backdrop of mountains and palm trees.

findings.quote: complementing the resort’s seven expansive pools with a backdrop of majestic mountains and palm trees.
findings.note: Pools set against mountains and palm trees.

claims.text: The resort has walking and biking trails and tennis courts.

findings.quote: Enjoy one of the many walking and biking trails throughout our Palm Springs resort or get in a game of tennis on our courts.
findings.note: Covers the trails and the tennis courts.

claims.text: The resort's one- and two-bedroom villas have expansive living rooms and private furnished backyards.

findings.quote: stay in one of our 43 luxurious one-and two-bedroom villas with high-quality amenities, expansive living rooms and private furnished backyards.
findings.note: Covers the expansive living rooms and private furnished backyards.

claims.text: The One Bedroom Villa has a living space with a fireplace, a dining area with a wet bar, a private patio with a barbecue, and views of the mountains and golf course.

findings.quote: expansive residential living space with fireplace, dining area with wet bar, and private furnished patio with barbeque. Step out to stunning views of the mountains and golf course.
findings.note: From the One Bedroom Villa description; covers every element.

claims.text: Rooms have a spa-inspired marble bathroom with a separate shower and tub, and a private balcony.

findings.quote: retreat to a spa-inspired marble bathroom with separate shower and tub. Find tranquility on a private balcony

claims.text: Ground-floor 2 King Beds with Pool Access rooms have easy access to the pool and an outdoor patio.

findings.quote: Located on the ground floor, this 550-square-foot room offers easy access to the pool along with an outdoor patio, a living area with a workspace and two king beds.
findings.note: 2 King Beds with Pool Access description.

claims.text: Tía Carmen is an upscale restaurant by chef Angelo Sosa that pays homage to the Southwest's stories, land and farmers.

findings.quote: Tía Carmen, by renowned chef Angelo Sosa, draws inspiration from Sosa’s aunt and pays homage to the beauty of the Southwest’s stories, land and farmers through an upscale dining experience.

claims.text: Private dining in the villas ranges from BBQ packages and personal chef experiences to charcuterie boards and wine selections.

findings.quote: Enjoy elevated dining in the privacy of your villa, from BBQ packages and personal chef experiences to charcuterie boards, wine selections, small bites, and self-service bar options.

claims.text: The Living Desert Zoo and Gardens and the shops of El Paseo are nearby.

findings.quote: Visit the nearby Living Desert Zoo and Gardens, shop at The Gardens on El Paseo and El Paseo village

claims.text: The resort was named in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2023 and 2025.

findings.note: Condé Nast Traveler page lists both years.

claims.text: HyTides Plunge is a three-story water park attraction with dueling waterslides, a lazy river and a splash pad.

findings.quote: The three-story attraction features 30-foot dueling waterslides and a 450-foot lazy river and splash pad
findings.note: Refers to HyTides Plunge in the same paragraph.

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Villa with Premium Outdoor Terrace has a terrace with an elevated daybed, a hot tub and a fire pit.

findings.quote: The outdoor terrace offers breathtaking views, an elevated daybed, a hot tub and a fire pit
findings.note: Two Bedroom Villa with Premium Outdoor Terrace.

findings.quote: guests are treated to breathtaking views, an elevated daybed, a hot tub, and a fire pit
findings.note: Same features on the room detail page.

claims.text: The Presidential Villa opens to golf course or lagoon views and has a private patio with an outdoor spa and a barbecue.

findings.quote: Sliding glass doors lead to golf course or lagoon views, private furnished patio with outdoor spa and with barbeque.

claims.text: Agua Serena Spa offers facials, massages and body treatments, a yoga studio and classes, wellness consultations and a 24-hour fitness studio.

findings.quote: Agua Serena Spa offers facials, massages and body treatments, a yoga studio and classes, wellness consultations and a 24-hour fitness studio.

claims.text: Villa stays include complimentary spa access.

findings.note: Listed among the One Bedroom Villa amenities; also listed for the other villas on d2.

claims.text: A daily resort fee is applied to each room.

findings.quote: A daily resort fee of $45.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

claims.text: Palm Springs International Airport is 12 miles away.

findings.note: From the parking and transportation page.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the location requires a car or transport to reach Palm Springs dining and nightlife.
